title: Print Queue Age Across Workshop
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=octoprint:job state=queued
| stats max(queue_age_min) as oldest_queue_min, count as queued_jobs by printer
| where oldest_queue_min>60 OR queued_jobs>3
| sort - oldest_queue_min
description: Uses OctoPrint queue metadata telemetry to monitor how long queued jobs have been waiting in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for print backlog that is longer than the workshop expects, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest OctoPrint queue metadata data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Printer table of oldest queue age and queue size.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how long queued jobs have been waiting so you can spot print backlog that is longer than the workshop expects before it becomes annoying.
